Link Telegram

Telegram connects with a bot token, not a QR code.
Saving the token registers the webhook automatically.

Checking…
  1. In Telegram, message @BotFather.
  2. Send /newbot and follow the prompts.
  3. Copy the token it gives you and paste it below.

The token is encrypted before it is stored and never returned again. Saving it registers the webhook straight away, so there is no second step — if the server has no public API_URL configured, the status will say so rather than looking connected while receiving nothing.
